## 11-day education equality campaign starts in Balaghat
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/11-day-education-equality-campaign-starts-in-balaghat/
Published: 2026-11-17T04:21:31.161Z
Topic: MP Exams and Jobs
Quick answer: An 11-day campaign for equal access to quality education began in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh on November 15. Organized by a committee, the yatra will travel to Bhopal by November 25, passing through Seoni, Chhindwara, Betul, and Narmadapuram districts.
Key points:
- 11-day education equality campaign launched in Balaghat
- Yatra runs November 15-25 from Balaghat to Bhopal
- Route covers Seoni, Chhindwara, Betul, Narmadapuram
- Committee demands equal access to quality education

## CBSE launches Expression Series on gender equality for Classes III-XII
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/cbse-launches-expression-series-on-gender-equality-for-classes-iii-xii/
Published: 2026-11-17T04:19:31.161Z
Topic: CBSE
Quick answer: CBSE has launched its 2026-27 Expression Series for students in Classes III through XII, centered on women empowerment and gender equality with age-appropriate themes. Schools are encouraged to sensitize students on these topics, and entries must be submitted by Tuesday.
Key points:
- CBSE's 2026-27 Expression Series focuses on women empowerment and gender equality
- Open to students from Classes III to XII with age-wise themes
- Entries due by Tuesday
- Aims to sensitize students on gender equality importance
- Part of CBSE's academic session activities
Original source: Times of India - https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/delhi/cbse-puts-gender-equality-in-the-classroom-conversation/articleshow/135893612.cms

## NEET 2026: Float and Freeze option leaves medical seats vacant
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/neet-2026-float-and-freeze-option-leaves-medical-seats-vacant/
Published: 2026-11-17T04:17:31.161Z
Topic: NEET
Quick answer: The 2026 NEET counselling introduced a Float and Freeze option allowing candidates to carry forward seat allotments without completing admission formalities. Even if seats remain unchanged in Round 3, candidates can decline to join. This flexibility has led to significant seat underutilisation, with hundreds of medical seats…
Key points:
- Float and Freeze option introduced in 2026 NEET counselling
- Candidates can hold allotments without completing admission
- Seats can be declined even after Round 3 allotment
- Flexibility linked to hundreds of vacant medical seats
- Millions of students appeared for NEET 2026
Original source: The Hindu - https://www.thehindu.com/education/millions-of-students-take-neet-yet-hundreds-of-medical-seats-go-vacant/article71707087.ece

## Bangladesh clothing factories close as workers strike for higher pay
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/news/bangladesh-clothing-factories-close-as-workers-strike-for-higher-pay/
Published: 2026-11-16T01:53:01.909Z
Topic: World
Quick answer: Clothing factories across Bangladesh have shut down after workers went on strike demanding a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka, equivalent to about £182.
Key points:
- Workers strike demanding 30,000 taka monthly minimum wage
- Clothing factories shut down due to strike action
- Demand equals approximately £182 per month

## RBI to auction 91-day, 182-day and 364-day Treasury Bills on Nov 18
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/rbi-to-auction-91-day-182-day-and-364-day-treasury-bills-on-nov-18/
Published: 2026-11-15T04:15:53.059Z
Topic: Banking
Quick answer: The Reserve Bank of India has announced an auction of three Government of India Treasury Bills on November 18, 2026, totalling ₹23,000 crore. The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each, and the 364-day bill at ₹7,000 crore. Settlement is on November 19, 2026.
Key points:
- The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each.
- The 364-day bill is notified at ₹7,000 crore, taking the total to ₹23,000 crore.
- Bids will be submitted electronically on the RBI's E-Kuber system on November 18.
- Retail investors can bid non-competitively, capped at 5 percent of the notified amount.
- Successful bidders must pay on November 19, 2026.
Original source: RBI - https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63975
